title: Puebla Cathedral
scope: The standing Puebla Cathedral exterior with its paired west bell towers, triple west portals, stepped nave and glazed crossing dome.
limitations: Fine sculpture, glaze ornament and the exact rear elevations are generalized.
The model covers the principal exterior envelope. Separately mapped surroundings, the atrium and the interior fall outside this scope.
Thirty-metre surface elevation is coarser than facade-level grade changes.
